extras: Desktop only; mobile Obsidian is not supported. Local features work offline after model installation; YouTube caption import needs an internet connection. Optional remote AI providers can receive transcript text, but audio is never uploaded. Some models require license review before installation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn speech or media into notes, translate text locally, or read notes aloud without cloud services.

relations.evidence: Import YouTube captions: Paste a link and bring available captions into your note

summary: Desktop speech toolkit for live dictation, local audio/video transcription, YouTube caption import, translation, read-aloud, and optional AI text refinement.
